description: This file defines the HelpBlock class for Drupal, implementing a custom block plugin that displays help information based on module hooks, with dependency injection and cache context management.

classes.name: HelpBlock
classes.description: A Drupal block plugin class that provides a help section, utilizing dependency injection, hook invocation, and cache context management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies: request, module handler, and route match.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate HelpBlock with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the render array for the help block, excluding pages with exceptions, invoking help hooks, and preparing markup.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts including the current route.
